The '''Teirasa system''' was located in the [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Teirasan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the Republic launched the [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade]] against the Teirasans in [[11,660 BBY]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] advanced toward the Teirasa system from the [[Kalarba system/Legends|Kalarba]], [[Ord Dorlass system/Legends|Ord Dorlass]], and [[Ord Zynthar system/Legends|Ord Zynthar systems]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Teirasa system was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed it in grid square O-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
